description: This source file defines a final class ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier that implements Supplier<Config>. It provides environment-specific configuration loading for a service, distinguishing between cloud, docker, file-based, and development environments. The class initializes configurations based on environment variables or resource files and exposes methods to get the appropriate Config object accordingly.

classes.name: ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier
classes.description: A supplier class that provides environment-specific configuration for a service based on the hosting environment. It determines the environment from system variables or passed parameters and loads the corresponding config resources or settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier with the specified service name, initializing environment from system environment variables.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the Config object tailored to the detected hosting environment, loading configs from resources or static values.

methods.name: determineHostingEnvironment
methods.description: Determines the hosting environment based on the systemHostingEnvironment string, mapping to enum values.

methods.name: getDockerConfig
methods.description: Loads Docker-specific configuration from resource files and annotates it with environment info.

methods.name: getCloudConfig
methods.description: Loads cloud environment configuration from resources and annotates it.

methods.name: getFileBasedConfig
methods.description: Loads file-based environment configuration from a configured resource.

methods.name: getDevelopmentConfig
methods.description: Loads development environment configuration from resource files.

methods.name: getConfigFromResource
methods.description: Parses configuration resource files corresponding to different environments.

methods.name: getResourceBasename
methods.description: Constructs the resource basename using the service name and environment-specific suffix.

methods.name: withHostingEnvironmentValue
methods.description: Augments the given Config instance with the current hosting environment value.

methods.name: getHostingEnvironmentConfig
methods.description: Creates a ConfigValue object representing the current hosting environment string.
